mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, start_date, end_date, status FROM t_health_plan WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_health_plan (user_id, title, content, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_health_plan SET user_id=#{userId}, title=#{title}, content=#{content}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
